title: Machine learning optimized callogenesis in Justicia gendarussa Burm. f. and phytochemical profiling of in vitro derived callus and leaf extracts.
summary: Callus initiation and fresh-weight measurements tested predicted hormone combinations; no medicinal efficacy follows from metabolite profiling.
